=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LogRead.md ===
# Feature: Log Read

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261024 V1 |
| Description | Reads a JSON Lines execution log from a file path as UTF-8, one line at a time, ignoring blank lines. |
| Depends On  | ARCHITECTURE.md |
| Provides    | logfile line reader for a file path |
| Consumes    | - |

## Questions

- Q-005 (low, system_choice `skip-line`): a line whose bytes are not valid UTF-8 cannot parse as a JSON object, so it is skipped under the malformed-line rule rather than failing the run. Only an open or read failure of the file is operational (exit 1). Recorded in DECISIONS.json.

## Purpose

Provide the single entry point through which every report reads Drydock's LLM execution log. The reader yields each non-blank line as raw bytes in file order. Parsing, skipping, and aggregation happen downstream.

## Behavior

- The file path is opened and read as UTF-8 bytes, one line at a time.
- Lines that are empty or contain only whitespace are ignored and are not counted as skipped.
- Each non-blank line is passed on as raw bytes, with its one-based line number preserved for diagnostics.
- A file that cannot be opened or read returns an operational error to the caller, which maps it to exit 1.
- The reader never writes to the log file.

## Programmatic Acceptance

=== AC log-read-blank-lines ===
Intent: Blank lines are ignored by the line reader and do not appear in the yielded lines.
Suite: scoped
Requires: executable=go; scope=test

import os
import subprocess
import tempfile

from drydock_go import cli_runner

content = '{"execution_id":"a"}\n\n   \n{"execution_id":"b"}\n'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    path = os.path.join(tmp, "log.jsonl")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(content)
    code, out, err = cli_runner("summary", path)
    print(out)
    print(err)
    assert code == 0, (code, out, err)
    rows = out.splitlines()
    assert rows[0].startswith("records,skipped,"), out
    fields = rows[1].split(",")
    assert fields[0] == "2", out
    assert fields[1] == "0", out
=== END AC log-read-blank-lines ===

=== AC log-read-utf8 ===
Intent: The line reader reads the file as UTF-8 and a multibyte character inside a valid record is kept intact.
Suite: scoped
Requires: executable=go; scope=test

import tempfile

from drydock_go import cli_runner

record = '{"schema_version":1,"execution_id":"u-1","started_at":"2026-10-14T06:37:54.176Z","status":"succeeded","job":{"command_name":"plan \u00e9","target":"Caf\u00e9","llm":"claude","model":"haiku"},"result":{"returncode":0,"timed_out":false,"stats":{"cost_usd":0.5,"elapsed_ms":1000,"input_tokens":1,"cached_input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":1}}}\n'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    path = os.path.join(tmp, "log.jsonl")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(record)
    code, out, err = cli_runner("commands", path)
    print(out)
    print(err)
    assert code == 0, (code, out, err)
    rows = out.splitlines()
    assert rows[0] == "command,calls,failed,input_tokens,cached_tokens,output_tokens,minutes", out
    fields = rows[1].split(",")
    assert fields[0] == "plan \u00e9", out
=== END AC log-read-utf8 ===

=== AC log-read-missing-file ===
Intent: A log path that cannot be opened exits 1 with nothing on stdout.
Suite: scoped
Requires: executable=go; scope=test

import os
import tempfile

from drydock_go import cli_runner

    assert out == "", out
=== END AC log-read-missing-file ===

## User Acceptance

- None.

## Guardrails

- Blank lines are not counted as skipped (see LOG-002 and Rule 1).
- The reader never writes to the log being read.
- Standard library only.

# Feature: Log Skip

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261024 V1 |
| Description | Parses each non-blank log line as a JSON object, skips malformed, incomplete, and duplicate records with a stderr warning, and exposes the whole-file skipped count. |
| Depends On  | FEATURE-LogRead.md |
| Provides    | record parser with whole-file skipped count |
| Consumes    | logfile line reader |

## Questions

- Q-004 (material, system_choice `kept-only`): only kept records register an execution_id; a line skipped for a missing field does not block a later valid line with the same id. The sample passes under either reading. Recorded in DECISIONS.json.

## Purpose

Turn raw log lines into kept records and a whole-file skipped count. Malformed and duplicate lines are never fatal; they are skipped, counted, and reported on stderr.

## Behavior

- Each non-blank line is parsed as a JSON object. A line that is not a JSON object is skipped.
- A line is skipped when any of `execution_id`, `started_at`, `status`, `job.command_name`, or `job.target` is absent or not a non-empty string.
- A line whose `execution_id` already appeared on an earlier kept record is skipped. The first occurrence is kept.
- Each skipped line writes exactly one warning to standard error naming its one-based line number. Nothing is written to standard output.
- Skipping never changes the exit code.
- The skipped count covers the whole file and is independent of any filter.

## Programmatic Acceptance

=== AC log-skip-counts-and-exit ===
Intent: Non-object, incomplete, and malformed lines are skipped, counted in the summary, and do not change exit status.
Suite: scoped
Requires: executable=go; scope=test

import os
import tempfile

from drydock_go import cli_runner

good = '{"schema_version":1,"execution_id":"k-1","started_at":"2026-10-14T06:37:54.176Z","status":"succeeded","job":{"command_name":"plan","target":"T","llm":"claude","model":"haiku"},"result":{"returncode":0,"timed_out":false,"stats":{"cost_usd":0.1,"elapsed_ms":1000,"input_tokens":1,"cached_input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":1}}}'
lines = [good, "not json", "[1,2,3]", '{"execution_id":"k-2","started_at":"2026-10-14T06:37:54.176Z","status":"succeeded","job":{"command_name":"plan"}}']
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    path = os.path.join(tmp, "log.jsonl")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    code, out, err = cli_runner("summary", path)
    print(out)
    print(err)
    assert code == 0, (code, out, err)
    fields = out.splitlines()[1].split(",")
    assert fields[0] == "1", out
    assert fields[1] == "3", out
=== END AC log-skip-counts-and-exit ===

=== AC log-skip-duplicate-first-kept ===
Intent: A duplicate execution_id is skipped on its later occurrence and the first occurrence is kept.
Suite: scoped
Requires: executable=go; scope=test

import os
import tempfile

from drydock_go import cli_runner

first = '{"schema_version":1,"execution_id":"d-1","started_at":"2026-10-14T06:37:54.176Z","status":"succeeded","job":{"command_name":"plan","target":"T","llm":"claude","model":"haiku"},"result":{"returncode":0,"timed_out":false,"stats":{"cost_usd":0.1,"elapsed_ms":1000,"input_tokens":1,"cached_input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":1}}}'
second = '{"schema_version":1,"execution_id":"d-1","started_at":"2026-10-15T06:37:54.176Z","status":"failed","job":{"command_name":"build","target":"T","llm":"claude","model":"haiku"},"result":{"returncode":1,"timed_out":false,"stats":{"cost_usd":0.9,"elapsed_ms":9000,"input_tokens":9,"cached_input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":9}}}'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    path = os.path.join(tmp, "log.jsonl")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(first + "\n" + second + "\n")
    code, out, err = cli_runner("summary", path)
    print(out)
    print(err)
    assert code == 0, (code, out, err)
    fields = out.splitlines()[1].split(",")
    assert fields[0] == "1", out
    assert fields[1] == "1", out
    assert fields[2] == "1", out
    assert fields[3] == "0", out
=== END AC log-skip-duplicate-first-kept ===

=== AC log-skip-warning-per-line ===
Intent: Each skipped line writes exactly one stderr warning naming its line number, and nothing is written to stdout for skips.
Suite: scoped
Requires: executable=go; scope=test

import os
import tempfile

from drydock_go import cli_runner

good = '{"schema_version":1,"execution_id":"w-1","started_at":"2026-10-14T06:37:54.176Z","status":"succeeded","job":{"command_name":"plan","target":"T","llm":"claude","model":"haiku"},"result":{"returncode":0,"timed_out":false,"stats":{"cost_usd":0.1,"elapsed_ms":1000,"input_tokens":1,"cached_input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":1}}}'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    path = os.path.join(tmp, "log.jsonl")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("garbage\n" + good + "\n")
    code, out, err = cli_runner("summary", path)
    print(out)
    print(err)
    assert code == 0, (code, out, err)
    warnings = [line for line in err.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    assert len(warnings) == 1, err
    assert "1" in warnings[0], err
    assert "garbage" not in out, out
=== END AC log-skip-warning-per-line ===

## User Acceptance

- None.

## Guardrails

- Skipping never changes the exit code (Rule 2).
- Skipped-line warnings go to standard error only and are never compared by the grader.
- The skipped count is computed over the whole file regardless of filters (Rule 6).

# Feature: Log Model

# Feature: Log Numbers

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261024 V1 |
| Description | Treats absent or null token counts, cost, and elapsed time as zero, and keeps a record without result.stats as a record. |
| Depends On  | FEATURE-LogSkip.md |
| Provides    | Record token, cost, and elapsed accessors defaulting to zero |
| Consumes    | record parser |

## Questions

- None.

## Purpose

Let every aggregate sum numeric stats safely, so that partial or absent statistics never fail a run or drop a record.

## Behavior

- `input_tokens`, `cached_input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cost_usd`, and `elapsed_ms` each default to zero when absent or `null`.
- A record with no `result.stats` object is still a kept record and contributes zero to every numeric aggregate.
- Accessors return these values to the aggregation code; no numeric field causes a skip.

## Programmatic Acceptance

=== AC log-numbers-null-and-absent-are-zero ===

    assert fields[7] == "0", out

# Feature: Log Failed

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261024 V1 |
| Description | Classifies a kept record as failed when its status is any value other than succeeded, and exposes the fields the failures report needs. |
| Depends On  | FEATURE-LogSkip.md |
| Provides    | Record.Failed, nullable returncode, timed_out |
| Consumes    | record parser |

## Questions

- None.

## Purpose

Identify failed calls for the summary, command, target, model, daily, and failures reports.

## Behavior

- A record is failed when `status` is any value other than `succeeded`.
- The record exposes `started_at`, `job.target`, `job.command_name`, its model (per FEATURE-LogModel), `result.returncode` as nullable, and `result.timed_out` for the failures report.
- `returncode` is absent or `null` when the record has no return code; `timed_out` is treated as false when absent.

    path = os.path.join(tmp, "log.jsonl")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(ok + "\n" + bad + "\n")
    code, out, err = cli_runner("summary", path)
    print(out)
    print(err)
    assert code == 0, (code, out, err)
    fields = out.splitlines()[1].split(",")
    assert fields[0] == "2", out
    assert fields[2] == "1", out
    assert fields[3] == "1", out
=== END AC log-failed-status-classification ===

=== AC log-failed-returncode-and-timeout ===
Intent: The failures report shows an empty returncode for a null return code and true for timed_out.
Suite: scoped
Requires: executable=go; scope=test

import tempfile

from drydock_go import cli_runner

bad = '{"schema_version":1,"execution_id":"f-3","started_at":"2026-10-14T06:38:54.176Z","status":"failed","job":{"command_name":"diagnose","target":"T","llm":"claude","model":"sonnet"},"result":{"returncode":null,"timed_out":true,"stats":{"cost_usd":0.1,"elapsed_ms":1000,"input_tokens":1,"cached_input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":1}}}'

- None.

## Guardrails

- A failed record is any status other than `succeeded` (Rule 5).

## Purpose

Turn raw log lines into kept records and a whole-file skipped count. Malformed and duplicate lines are never fatal; they are skipped, counted, and reported on stderr.

## Behavior

- Each non-blank line is parsed as a JSON object. A line that is not a JSON object is skipped.
- A line is skipped when any of `execution_id`, `started_at`, `status`, `job.command_name`, or `job.target` is absent or not a non-empty string.
- A line whose `execution_id` already appeared on an earlier kept record is skipped. The first occurrence is kept.
- Each skipped line writes exactly one warning to standard error naming its one-based line number. Nothing is written to standard output.
- Skipping never changes the exit code.
- The skipped count covers the whole file and is independent of any filter.

# Feature: Log Numbers

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261024 V1 |
| Description | Treats absent or null token counts, cost, and elapsed time as zero, and keeps a record without result.stats as a record. |
| Depends On  | FEATURE-LogSkip.md |
| Provides    | Record token, cost, and elapsed accessors defaulting to zero |
| Consumes    | record parser |

## Questions

- None.

## Purpose

Let every aggregate sum numeric stats safely, so that partial or absent statistics never fail a run or drop a record.

## Behavior

- `input_tokens`, `cached_input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cost_usd`, and `elapsed_ms` each default to zero when absent or `null`.
- A record with no `result.stats` object is still a kept record and contributes zero to every numeric aggregate.
- Accessors return these values to the aggregation code; no numeric field causes a skip.

# Feature: Log Failed

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261024 V1 |
| Description | Classifies a kept record as failed when its status is any value other than succeeded, and exposes the fields the failures report needs. |
| Depends On  | FEATURE-LogSkip.md |
| Provides    | Record.Failed, nullable returncode, timed_out |
| Consumes    | record parser |

## Questions

- None.

## Purpose

Identify failed calls for the summary, command, target, model, daily, and failures reports.

## Behavior

- A record is failed when `status` is any value other than `succeeded`.
- The record exposes `started_at`, `job.target`, `job.command_name`, its model (per FEATURE-LogModel), `result.returncode` as nullable, and `result.timed_out` for the failures report.
- `returncode` is absent or `null` when the record has no return code; `timed_out` is treated as false when absent.
